messages:
maya: Heads-up from billing smoke: preview invoices for tenants routed via policy=multi-model are ~2.7% higher since the routing tweak last night. Not visible in per-request logs.

tom: I think streaming path is emitting stream_chunk token events and then finalize_token also emits. Our dedupe key included route in v1; if the route changes (fallback) between events we double count.

priya: Short example: stream_chunk -> route=multi-model, finalize -> route=fallback-small. Same fingerprint, different dedupe key -> counted twice. Seen on a few accounts.

dan: We added route to dedupe to avoid cross-tenant collisions historically, but in practice it's causing this split.

maya: Quick mitigation request: can we debounce stream_chunk into metering for X seconds if a finalize follows? cheap fix.

priya: Longer-term safer option: add canonical_fingerprint and dedupe_schema_version fields. Aggregator prefers canonical_fingerprint when present; old behavior remains as fallback. Ingest libs to emit canonical_fp via header flag to speed rollout.

nate: Rollout idea: 1) aggregator parses canonical_fp but keeps legacy mode; 2) enable canonical dedupe in 5% canary; 3) run 24h shadow compare and compute invoice delta; 4) ramp if delta <0.1%. Block preview emails for canary tenants until we verify.

ingest-bot: alert: schema:v3 status: ~92% edge nodes emitting canonical_fp, missing nodes in eu-west-1 proxies.

tom: SQL used for detection:
```
SELECT fingerprint, count(*) AS cnt, array_agg(distinct route) AS routes
FROM metering_events
WHERE invoice_window = '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY fingerprint
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Most dup candidates have multiple routes in the routes array.

priya: Backfill plan: scan finalize events and infer canonical_fp for earlier stream_chunks where possible, mark and re-ingest corrected events for preview. Need ops + finance OK for mass credits.

dan: Console asks: add per-route "dedupe_mode" (v1/v2) flag in invoice preview and a metric dup_candidate_rate (% fingerprints with >1 event). Finance wants to see that before flip.

finance-bot: @finance-ops flagged: prepare credit-adjustment runbook if backfill affects previews.

maya: Emergency stopgap: implement time-window suppression in aggregator: if same fingerprint seen within 45s, suppress second event regardless of route. Toggle as kill-switch only.

nate: I'll define canary cohorts and ensure preview emails are suppressed for cohort tenants. Will post cohort list here.

priya: I'll open PR for aggregator: add canonical_fingerprint field, dedupe_schema_version flag, feature flag to enable canonical dedupe, and shadow-compare plumbing. Unit tests will cover mixed-route cases.

tom: Post-rollout monitors: dup_candidate_rate, finalize_lag_histogram, canary_delta_percent. Alert if canary_delta > 0.2% or dup_candidate_rate goes up after flip.

maya: Action items recap: priya -> PR + tests + docs; nate -> canary cohort + block preview emails; tom -> dashboards + alerts + SQL queries; dan -> backfill plan + finance coordination; ops -> patch eu-west proxies.

priya: Timeline: PRs today, canary deploy 08:00 UTC tomorrow, observe 12h then decide.

maya: Thanks team. Keep updates here and paste canary metrics. If spike shows up outside canary, page oncall.
